fields.name: sheet
fields.label: Sheet number
fields.description: Formatted like A-107. Each project needs its own.

fields.name: area
fields.label: Area
fields.description: For example 240 m2. Optional.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Your role
fields.description: For example Project architect.

fields.name: contribution
fields.label: What you personally did
fields.description: Kept separate from the project description on purpose. On team projects this is what a reviewer is assessing.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One line summary
fields.description: Shown under the project title and in search results.

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Credit, short
fields.description: Who did the work, in a few words, for the project card. For example Sole author, With Kyle Mo, Group of five. Required: a portfolio that does not say which projects were group work is misleading, and a reviewer assumes the worst when it is missing.

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Where it sits on the projects page
fields.description: The top three are the large cards. The set is the strip under them. The archive is the short list at the bottom, for coursework that should stay on the site without competing with the strong work. Only three can be in the top three: a fourth falls into the set rather than disappearing.

options.label: The archive, a line in the list

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order in the set
fields.description: Lower numbers come first.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Choose a file, or drag one in. It is stored with the site.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describe the drawing for someone who cannot see it. Required.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Choose a file, or drag one in. It is stored with the site.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describe the drawing for someone who cannot see it. Required.

fields.name: drawings
fields.label: Drawings
fields.description: Plans, sections and elevations. These open full screen.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Choose a file, or drag one in. It is stored with the site.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describe the drawing for someone who cannot see it. Required.

fields.name: drawingType
fields.label: Drawing type
fields.description: For example Ground floor plan, Long section.

fields.name: film
fields.label: Walkthrough film
fields.description: Leave every box empty if this project has no film. A film needs a poster frame and either an uploaded file or a YouTube link.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Film file
fields.description: The walkthrough itself. Upload it here, or type the path of a file already in the bucket.

fields.name: youtube
fields.label: YouTube id or link
fields.description: An alternative to uploading. Unlisted is fine. Paste the id or the whole link. Ignored when a film file is set above.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster frame
fields.description: The still shown before the film plays. Required for a film to appear.

fields.name: credential
fields.label: Credentials
fields.description: For example OAA, MRAIC.

fields.name: issued
fields.label: Issue date
fields.description: Appears in the title block, formatted like 2026.07.

fields.name: welcome
fields.label: Welcome line
fields.description: The small line above the name on the home page.

fields.name: positioning
fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: The paragraph under the name on the home page.

fields.name: cvFile
fields.label: CV PDF path
fields.description: Put the PDF in public/cv/ and enter its path, for example /cv/ahmad-assi-cv.pdf. Leave empty to hide the download button.

fields.name: portfolioFile
fields.label: Portfolio PDF path
fields.description: Generated from this site by npm run portfolio, so the PDF and the link always show the same projects in the same order. Leave empty to hide the download button.

fields.name: facts
fields.label: Cover sheet facts
fields.description: The four scannable facts under the cover rule.

fields.name: period
fields.label: Period
fields.description: For example 2021 to present.

fields.name: references
fields.label: References note
fields.description: Shown at the foot of the resume page.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
